content.text: (c) Lower valve body slightly, and install the accumulator piston retaining plate. Hold in place with two pan bolts, finger tight.

content.description: Illustration showing the disconnection of throttle cable from cam

content.text: (d) Disconnect the throttle cable from the cam and remove the valve body.
DISASSEMBLY, INSPECTION AND ASSEMBLY OF VALVE BODY

items.heading: CONNECT THROTTLE CABLE TO CAM
items.text: Push the cable fitting into the cam.

items.heading: REMOVE ACCUMULATOR RETAINING PLATE
items.text: Remove the two pan bolts, and slide out the plate.

content.description: Illustration showing the accumulator retaining plate removal from valve body

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Align the manual valve lever with the manual valve.

content.description: Illustration showing alignment of manual valve lever during valve body installation

content.text: (b) Install the B2 and C2 accumulator piston springs.
